basis: local candidate only; no deployed/canonical acceptance

findings.finding: delete_source reads facts before acquiring a source-job lock; concurrent commit can add an ACTIVE fact after deletion has read the old facts and before values_deleted is set. SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE masks the PostgreSQL interleaving.
findings.required: Lock existing source jobs in stable import_job_id order before reading facts, use compatible lock order from disconnect, then prove rollback and commit-after-delete denial.
findings.limits: Source creation phantom insertion is a separate concurrency boundary; this fix alone does not prove it.

findings.origin: Root discovery independently confirmed by C14 code inspection
findings.finding: create_import persists arbitrary metadata. A same-user fake connection_intent can point import_job_id to another user. disconnect fetches that row by unscoped primary key and its non-delete branch mutates the foreign source_disconnected flag.
findings.required: Reject reserved connection metadata at untrusted import input and validate user/provider/source association before imported-row mutation; prove zero foreign writes on rejection.
